name: mindslice
description: Portable long-term memory: isolated Markdown slices, standing memory in every session, controlled evolution.

workspace.title: Memory workspace
workspace.description: Folder that holds your memory. An existing MindSlice workspace is used as is; a new or empty folder is initialized.

stage_writes.title: Review every write
stage_writes.description: Send every change the agent makes to staging for your approval (recommended for small local models).

python.title: Python command
python.description: Command that starts Python 3.12 or newer for the MindSlice MCP server. Keep python3 on Linux and macOS; on Windows use py (the Python launcher) or the full path of python.exe.
